text:
Maya Rodriguez: Figma link with new streaming layout: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/playground-streaming-v3 Samir Patel: Nice. My quick thought: move local token counter off the bottom rail and pair it with the prompt selector. Eli Chen: pairing makes sense. token counter near the prompt reduces eye jump when you change prompts. Jordan Lee: question — if we hide the token counter by default, can it be toggled with keyboard? keyboard accessibility is a must. Aria Gomez: agree. Also copy: can we change "Stop" to "Pause" for streaming? "Stop" feels final when a user expects to resume. Maya Rodriguez: good call. UX goal is reduce fear of regenerating. Pause/regenerate flow: pause keeps state, regenerate starts fresh. Samir Patel: small nit: token counter should show both total and session delta like "345 (+12)" so you know incremental cost. Eli Chen: accessibility nit: need aria-live region for streaming text and an aria-pressed state for the pause button. DesignBot: screenshot uploaded: https://img.redwood.internal/s/stream_v3.png :eyes: Jordan Lee: screenshot looks good. But prompt library collapse behavior — when a prompt is selected, should the rail auto-collapse to show more canvas? pros/cons? Aria Gomez: prefer auto-collapse with motion reduced option. also add an on/off toggle in settings for users that rely on the rail. Maya Rodriguez: action items: - Samir: mock token counter with delta and tooltip copy - Eli: add aria attributes + keyboard shortcut `Shift+S` doc - Jordan: prototype auto-collapse with reduced motion toggle I'll update the figma and ping again. :thumbsup: Samir Patel: thanks Maya — one more: show token tooltip on hover with pricing estimate.
